title: mentha longifolia var. kotschyana
intro: Mentha longifolia var. kotschyana, commonly known as Egyptian mint or Kotschy's horsemint, is a subspecies of the mint plant native to the Middle East and North Africa. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various ailments such as digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Mentha longifolia var. kotschyana include its ability to relax muscles, reduce stress, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
